question: How many days do I have to return an item?
answer: You can return an item within 21 days of its delivery date. The delivery date is shown as "Delivered" in your order history; if the carrier recorded no delivery date, the window starts 7 days after the order date. A return request sent on the 21st day counts as on time, even if the parcel reaches the seller later.

question: How much does it cost to return an item I simply changed my mind about?
answer: Returning an item you changed your mind about costs €3.95, which is deducted from your refund. This covers the prepaid label and is the same for every carrier and country. Alternatively, you can send the item back at your own expense with a tracked service and pay nothing to us, as long as you enter the tracking number in your return request.

question: Can I return a mascara I have opened?
answer: No, you cannot return an opened mascara under normal circumstances. Mascara is a make-up product applied near the eyes, and for health and hygiene reasons, opened make-up products cannot be returned once their seal has been broken. However, there is one exception: if the mascara is defective, damaged on arrival, not as described, or caused a confirmed allergic reaction, you can return it even if opened, within 21 days of delivery.

question: My parcel is 3 days past its estimated delivery date. What can I do?
answer: Your parcel is considered late since it hasn't arrived 2 days after its estimated delivery date. You can cancel the order from your order history and receive a full refund, including the delivery cost, within 5 business days—you don't need to wait for the parcel to arrive. If the parcel arrives after you've cancelled, you can refuse it or send it back using the prepaid label we'll email you.

question: Which carriers deliver to Belgium?
answer: All four carriers deliver to Belgium: Albatros Parcels, Blue Heron Logistics, Kestrel Freight, and Swift Otter Delivery.

question: Is delivery free for a €30 order?
answer: No, delivery is not free for a €30 order. Delivery is free only for orders of €35 or more per seller. For orders below €35, delivery costs €4.90 per seller in every country.

question: Can I pay by bank transfer?
answer: No, Albert's Marketplace accepts payment by card only: Visa, Mastercard and American Express. We do not accept bank transfers, cash on delivery, cheques or gift cards from other shops.

question: How long after I close my account is my data deleted?
answer: When you close your account, your personal data is deleted within 30 days. However, invoices and payment records are kept for 10 years as required by law.

question: What commission does a seller pay on each sale?
answer: A seller pays a 12% commission on each sale, with the delivery cost excluded from the calculation. This commission is deducted from each payout.

question: Is the KAO Nivea UV sunscreen gel suitable for oily skin?
answer: Yes, the KAO Nivea UV Deep Protect & Care Gel SPF 50+ is suitable for oily skin. It is a light sunscreen gel that leaves no white cast, making it an appropriate choice for oily skin types.

question: Combien coûte un retour si j'ai simplement changé d'avis ?
answer: Un retour coûte 3,95 € s'il n'est pas motivé par un défaut, un dommage ou une non-conformité de la commande. Ce coût est déduit de votre remboursement et couvre l'étiquette prépayée. Vous pouvez aussi renvoyer l'article à vos frais avec un service suivi, auquel cas vous ne payez rien à Albert's Marketplace.

question: What is the phone number of customer service?
answer: I don't have a phone number for customer service in my available information. Albert's Marketplace customers contact sellers through the marketplace platform itself.

question: Do you offer gift wrapping?
answer: I don't have information about gift wrapping services in our help centre. Please contact our customer service team for details about this option.

question: How long is a password reset link valid?
answer: A password reset link is valid for 1 hour. You can request a reset link by clicking "Forgot password" on the sign-in page.

question: Can I use two discount codes on the same order?
answer: No, you can only use one discount code per order. If you have multiple codes, you'll need to choose which one to apply at checkout.

question: How much does delivery cost for a €20 order?
answer: Delivery costs €4.90 for orders under €35. Since your order is €20, you will pay €4.90 for delivery, and this cost will be shown before you complete your purchase.

question: My parcel has shown no movement for 12 days. What can I do?
answer: Your parcel is considered lost since the carrier has shown no movement for 10 days. You can report it from your order page, and we will refund you in full within 5 business days, or send a replacement if the seller has stock available, depending on what you prefer.

question: How long do I have to report a parcel that arrived damaged?
answer: You have 48 hours after delivery to report a damaged parcel. When you report it, please include a photo of the parcel as it was delivered and a photo of the damaged item. The return will be free, and you can choose between a refund or a replacement.

question: Can I change the delivery address once my order is in transit?
expected_facts: no longer|cannot be changed|can't be changed|contact the carrier
answer: No, you cannot change the delivery address once your order is in transit. You can only change the address while the order is still Processing. Once the carrier has the parcel, you will need to contact the carrier directly with your tracking number if you need to modify the delivery address.

question: How quickly am I refunded once my return is confirmed?
answer: Once your return is confirmed, you are refunded within 5 business days to the card you paid with. Your bank may take a few more days to show the refund in your account.

question: I was charged twice. When will the second charge be refunded?
answer: If both charges appear as collected on your statement after 3 business days, you can report the double charge from your order page with a screenshot of your statement. Albert's Marketplace will refund the second charge within 3 business days of your report.

question: Which cards do you accept?
answer: Albert's Marketplace accepts payment by card only: Visa, Mastercard, and American Express. We do not accept bank transfers, cash on delivery, cheques, or gift cards from other shops.

question: How often are sellers paid?
answer: Sellers on Albert's Marketplace are paid every 14 days by bank transfer for every order delivered at least 7 days before the payout date, minus commissions, subscription fees, and refunds. Payouts below €10 are carried over to the next payout period.

question: What monthly subscription does a seller with 60 sales in a month pay?
answer: A seller with 60 sales in a month pays a monthly subscription of €19.

question: Within how many days must a seller ship an order?
answer: According to Albert's Marketplace policy, a seller must ship every order within 2 business days of the order.

question: How many drops of the OZNaturals Retinol Serum should I apply?
answer: According to the product information, you should apply two or three drops of the OZNaturals Retinol Serum in the evening on clean, dry skin, then follow with a moisturiser. It is recommended to start with two evenings a week and use sunscreen the next day.

question: Combien de temps ai-je pour retourner un article ?
answer: Vous pouvez retourner un article dans les 21 jours suivant sa date de livraison. La date de livraison est celle indiquée comme « Livré » dans votre historique de commandes. Une demande de retour envoyée le 21e jour est acceptée, même si le colis arrive au vendeur plus tard.

question: Kann ich per Überweisung bezahlen?
answer: Nein, Albert's Marketplace akzeptiert nur Kartenzahlungen: Visa, Mastercard und American Express. Banküberweisung ist leider nicht möglich.
